svg.title: David Livingstone: African expeditions waypoint map
svg.desc: Real southern and central African coastlines with selected stops from 1841 to 1874.
svg.metadata: Natural Earth v5.1.2, 1:50 million, public domain. Generated by scripts/build-geography.mjs. Boundaries follow the dataset's de facto policy and are not an endorsement of sovereignty claims.
svg.text: Gold: 1852–56 crossing · Red: 1866–73 watershed search · Dashed green: Chuma & Susi’s 1873–74 memorial march · Blue: rivers
Natural Earth 50m · Mercator · boundaries shown are modern reference coastlines; stop links are approximate schematics
